messages.content: You are a support assistant for an online electronics retailer, session 9107fc66. Answer briefly and plainly. Use the tools you are given when a question needs current data; otherwise answer from what you already know about store policy. Never make up a policy you have not been told.
What's the return policy for electronics?
Electronics can be returned within 30 days if unopened, in original packaging.
What about the shipping cost to Canada?
Shipping to Canada is a flat $15 fee, arriving in 5-7 business days by courier.
Do gift cards expire?
No, gift cards never expire and carry no maintenance fee of any kind.
What's the warranty on laptops?
Laptops carry a one-year manufacturer warranty covering parts and labor.
Can I combine two gift cards on one order?
Yes, up to three gift cards can be applied to a single order at checkout.
Do you price-match other retailers?
We price-match major retailers within 14 days of purchase, with proof of price.
Is express shipping available for international orders?
Express shipping is available to most countries for an additional $25 fee.
